title: Notification profiles cannot be tested from Settings — Vault gets a Test Connection button, notifications get nothing
existing_state: The Vault settings tab has a 'Test Connection' button that exercises the in-dialog values end-to-end (SettingsDialog.cs:731). The Notifications tab (CreateNotificationsTab, SettingsDialog.cs:1180 onward) has only Add/Remove profile buttons (SettingsDialog.cs:1217-1220) and the config fields (webhook URL, SMTP host/port/from/to/credentials). There is no way to verify a Slack webhook URL, Teams flow URL, or SMTP relay actually works without leaving Settings, writing a YAML preset containing a notify: step, and running it — and since webhook URLs are stored write-only in Credential Manager and displayed masked (isPassword: true, SettingsDialog.cs:1295), a paste error is invisible until that first real send fails.
recommendation: Add a 'Send Test' button to the Notifications tab that builds a throwaway NotificationService from the current in-dialog field values (mirroring how the Vault Test Connection builds a throwaway VaultService from in-dialog textboxes) and sends a canned 'SSH_Helper test notification' to the selected profile, reporting the NotificationResult (status code / error body) inline next to the button.
user_benefit: Turns notification setup from a multi-step trial-and-error loop (save settings, write script, run, inspect) into a one-click verification — the same affordance every comparable tool (Grafana, Rundeck) provides.

evidence.note: Vault tab Test Connection button — the precedent

mockup_idea: Settings > Notifications tab mockup: a 'Send Test' button below the profile fields with an inline result label — green check 'Delivered (HTTP 200)' or red 'Failed: 404 no_service — check webhook URL'.
